Initial release of the SRU Library Query skill for Khánh Hòa Provincial Library.

- Enables searching the library’s catalog using CQL via https://sru.thuvienkhanhhoa.gov.vn.
- Supports keyword, author, title, and subject-based queries with structured JSON results.
- Implements robust error handling, including retries and helpful error messages.
- Provides functions for searching, retrieving specific records, and service metadata.
- Designed for easy integration with scripts and applications.
